content: 10:1-10 Qoan mian yab bigau qomon eng in qomon boru me birueinerei

Yuda wurinou qomon qoan eng in gab ete imbigun: mi uber qen geret dibeneriner eng qenein gas ende inimbig igo, qenein apand ue. End qomon qob ete igoai: togun gugum mian yamau qomon eng werei gari qas ende toat ebet igorubour. End ne qomon toat ne inorou munait isunor eng qomon eng wuri birogonima Qenu menmant qoregen me igorunorei.

Mian yab igour eng qomon boru wurit birogonima uber igorub ende qi eng bo sabar meimet qamb mian yab igour? Qomon igo end inorou munai mor isub qen gari qas mian yab big ne bo qomon boru init igo qamb misir me igunorei.
Wo ende ue end ne togun gugum qomon boru end misir igar qamb qenen mian yab wurinomi maragansi igour.
Bur qarig qeru qiyo a bur meme qeru eng qomon boru maigas me birogoniminerei.
Ende end ne Munon inubersiau tari wo ag e darab Qenu nob ete qamarei:

content.text: Wai waramb mian yomunor eng ne me netreminerei.Ego munon git goan ger yet arsi.
Wai ger waramb ten mutet wab wogub qomon boru wurit maragansi birogonimatar igour eng gor ne me qenungan.
End ye ete qemerini: io Qenu, ne yegab igoan. End qob qoan yet qamb gumatemir igo end ye e doroum eng nonou qob qoan qamara gumatemir eng toaibam.

content: Qen qamart qamar eng, qomon toat mian yab big igour end ete qamarei: “Ne wai waramb mian yab qiyo, a wai waramb ten mutet wab wogub qomon boru wurimaragansi birogoni qiyo, eng gagar me qenungan.”
Ende qamb ne bo qamar: “Io Qenu, ye e igoum. Ye e doroum eng nonou qob eng ye toaibam.” End ne Qenu qomon qoan eng biruet wogub qomon bubun eng uput qamb nonogursiarei.

End Munon inubersiau tari Yisas Qenu mi eb qamb wot qamar eng gugum toat ebeterei. Ebet wonou git goan end qen gari qas umb wogub init mian yab inmaragansiau gas ende ebet ininou qomon boru eng gugum biruet wogub in wonou munon qau inmaribigorei.
10:11-18 Munon inubersiau tari wo qeemben qomon boru init birueiba
Yuda munon mian yab igour eng qen gugum goten uter naget-naget mian yab igour eng, qomon boru bais me birogoni igamau.
Ego munon inubersiau tari wo qen gari qas mian yab inmaragansi qomon boru gugum birogoniamor eng qenen ende igoriba. Wo ende at wogub Qenu uberegent end bugamorei igo.
Igo ne Qenu wonou munon qarau eng wuriimurima daran erobon is igorunor eng qoat igo.
Wo qen gari qas munon wurimaragansia uber buremir eng wuri pangim igour end qenen bebereg igorubour.
End Igomurur qau gor ete dibes ininob qamb igo:
“Munon aib qamar: qen eng ubura ne qomon temen ger bo big wurit nausieribam. Qomon temen eng ete: qomon gugum wurinou misirt end gumat igimine ten igama ne igub igorubour.”
Ende qamb bo qamar: “Qomon eng ende igama ne wurinou qomon boru obounor end misir me iginei.”
End Qenu qomon boru gugum biruet ugea eng, bo sabar mian yamau qomon eng bo me igorinerei.
10:19-25 In Qenu qani isun
End ne munon banam, Yisas umb wogub qeru iger ai e iriget isuor end in qeemben munai tumbigi sig qau end iruboun end misir qebebi me igar.
Wo ininou igom igamau werei eng imotarerei. Mi goan gurum aib tend opur igoar eng wei mor isuor eng. Mi goan eng wonou git goan.
End ne ininou mian yamau munon baraitari gigit igo Qenu wonou munon yurau oroar igo.

Ininou qomon boru misirt igama igub igoun end wonou qeru eng bures init ariramorei. Ne wonou ya qiginnob end ininou git goan birogoniamorei. End ne ininou misir soagen-soagen eng mom nugutumuget wogub Qenut oabig wo qani isun.
Ininou oau apand dibes qamb igoun eng mi uber bauboun eng qoot igoun. End oau apand eng bo me bagiomun. In mom qoyam eng, Qenu wo mi init ebeib qamb iyeter eng apand mom ende ebet qas wegiba.
End ininou munon banam gor wurit igub wurimusiorune wuri oau meinburab qomon uber ebet munon qei wuribanamsiorunor.

Munon banam erogori qiumunimau eng an bais me wagar. Munon qei ebet igour gas ende me abar. An qenen wurinou misir eng nonogursiarar. Meimet qamb, Munon inubersiau tari bo deriner qen eng pi burab igo.
10:26-31 In Qenu wau me mogirt wab wogun
In Yisast mom oabig wogub bo sabar qomon boru toat qirun eng, qomon boru biruau eng werei ger ue.
In ende at qib eng, Qenu qarausiorun end wot yari qas igoruboun. Igo wonou mut aib Qenu wonou munon qarau mutet weriner end nob sori isuboun.
End Moses qomon qoan gumater eng in imbig igoun eng: Munon ger qomon biisita munon ombur qiyo, ombur gari ende gunor eng me toubunorei. Dibes qamarari mom waramari umiba.

End munon ger Qenu wau mogirt wab weginer end mai misir igoumon? Munon eng sig borusi qugurageteriba. Meimet qamb, Munon inubersiau tari wonou qeru eng munon eng birogonima qau burer end. Wo Yisas wonou qeru eng mi ar gas ende ba sumungasi ne Igomurur qau mag birebir qib igo end.
In mom qoyam, Munon Aib ete qamarei: “Qomon boru taui igaramau eng yonou ebeibam.” Ende qamb bo qamar: “Munon aib wonou munon yamangar nob qomon wuriqereimba.”
End Qenu qenen igo eng inba qubei wogub ininou qomon boru qereiminer eng in wot oau uburab isuboun.
10:32-39 In oau apand end nonoguretorun
End qoan an maigas igoumon qi eng imbig gaiar. Qoan an Qenu wonou qomon end igoumon end ansesimoar abari an git goan borusi migeri aningab igoar eng an mom nonoguret igumanei.
Qen qei anamar munon mag diban end an nagasi qob isi anit qamb anquguragsi igurei. Qen qei munon qei ende wurisiarari an der wurinob naget wurinonogursi igumanei.

Munon qei uyort igamari an wuritoubar igumanei. Qen qei munon qei an mi ba sumungasiari an wurit mismisir igumanei. An eng at igoumon eng, an mom qoyam. Mi uber qenen bebereg igoriner eng anit igoriner eng imbig at igumanei.
End aninou oau apand eng at igoumon eng bais ger me wagar. Qen geret mi git apand anit dibenara guboumon.
End an mom ende nonoguret Qenu qob eng ende toat igo wonomi uber anit iyet qamar eng baiar.
End Qenu qob ete qura:

content.text: Qen pi, munon deriner eng deribar eng. Wo gurum baab me derinerei.
End yonou munon qoregen eng wo oau apand igo end igomot igoriba. Ego wo mi eng gab oau uburab isiner eng, ye wo gab ieribam.”

content: End in munon yurau mi eng gab oau uburab isub mom umau ende ue. In munon yurau oabig ne qenen bebereg igamau eng e igoun.
